headlines.description: — New head coach. New Buffalo Bills stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen gets comfortable in Bills' new stadium with TD pass in 29-14 preseason win over Panthers

headlines.description: — It was a mixed bag for Deshaun Watson. Same for Shedeur Sanders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Deshaun Watson leads the Browns on 2 scoring drives in a 34-10 preseason loss to the Bears

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Everything is new for Kyler Murray after joining the Minnesota Vikings, so he made sure to soak in every little thing, from the flights and bus rides to the purple-and-white uniform.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray debuts as Minnesota's starting QB and Dart throws for a TD as Vikings beat Giants 13-10

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — There were a whole bunch of raised eyebrows when the Los Angeles Rams drafted Ty Simpson in the first round in April.
headlines.shortLinkText: First-round pick Ty Simpson throws 2 TD passes, rallies Rams past Chiefs 20-12 in preseason debut

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Zach Wilson, saddled with the “draft bust” label as he tries to salvage his NFL career, is giving the New Orleans Saints reasons to take him seriously as a potential backup to Tyler Shough.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zach Wilson stands out for the Saints in a 24-20 preseason loss to the Jaguars

headlines.description: — Rookie wide receiver Ja’Kobi Lane keeps turning heads. On Saturday night, so did his recently drafted teammates.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ja'Kobi Lane has TD catch on promising night for Ravens rookie receivers in 24-7 win over Eagles

headlines.description: — Rookie Camden Brown had two touchdown catches, including a diving, one-handed snag, to help lead the Dallas Cowboys past the Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks 17-7 on Saturday night in the preseason opener for both team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brown stands out for Cowboys with 2 TD catches in 17-7 win over Seahawks
